name: augnes-codex
description: Routes explicit Augnes continuity, setup, and memory-reuse requests to their current owners without priming ordinary source-first work.

interface.shortDescription: Guide explicit Augnes continuity, setup, and bounded memory reuse in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Routes shared Web work to its authenticated Web entry and registered local work to the reviewed Augnes Operator and Companion. Explicit memory reuse uses the bounded manual intake or an explicitly installed user-level hook. Ordinary development starts from source.
defaultPrompt: Review this PR with Augnes context
